task_instance: Make a SQL query live for a minimal chat app per the skill's Core Pattern: a backend that seals a read-only messages SELECT and returns each write's txid, plus a React component subscribing via useLiveQuery, then verify the query actually goes live by subscribing to it and seeing the initial result and committed-transaction changes.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is a working live-query setup on Neon's Realtime beta, which can only be produced and verified by running software this office-assistant runtime does not provide: installing the @neon/realtime SDK packages (beta, npm), running the neon CLI (neon deploy, neon realtime enable, and especially neon realtime subscribe to confirm the query is live and streaming committed changes), and executing the TypeScript backend/frontend. The runtime cannot run any code or command, cannot install software, and has no browser automation, so the code I wrote cannot be type-checked, bundled, deployed, subscribed to, or otherwise verified. (Secondary blockers that would also apply even with code execution: a Neon Lakebase project with a NEON_REALTIME_SECRET and NEON_REALTIME_URL, i.e. account/credentials, and a reachable Live SQL WebSocket service in a supported region.)
evidence: Read the SKILL.md. Chose the chat live-query instance it documents as the Core Pattern. Wrote a genuine representative backend attempt at backend/realtime.ts in the work directory (seals messagesQuery, returns pg_current_xact_id() txid on insert). To verify 'the SQL query is now live' the skill requires: npm install of @neon/realtime, @neon/realtime-drizzle, @neon/realtime-react; the neon CLI for deploy/enable and for `neon realtime subscribe "SELECT ..."` which prints the initial result then each transaction's changes; and env values NEON_REALTIME_SECRET/NEON_REALTIME_URL from a live Neon project. This runtime grants only text file read/write/edit and (disabled this round) web access: no shell, no code execution, no package install. So no part of the deliverable could be run or verified. The written code file exists but is unverifiable, so outcome is not_achieved.
